spec: Where each standalone emulator keeps a settings file, keyed by the %EMULATOR_…% token and then by the file's own name. This exists because the location was being stated once per question — a save card, a texture card and a mod card naming one path between them, with a fourth copy in the firmware resolver's code — and two of those statements had already drifted apart in shipped releases (#250, #256: one route read the config home while another read the data home for the same file). A card now names a file by NAME and the address lives here, once, so a disagreement is not expressible. What is here is only WHERE: bases in the order a launch may pick them, and the path below. What the file means for a question — which keys govern a save tree, whether a switch exists, how a legacy file is migrated — stays with the card and the code that read it. 'bases' is a list because one emulator's root is a property of its launch rather than of the emulator: DuckStation picks $XDG_CONFIG_HOME where that variable is set and absolute and the data home otherwise, so a reader probes in the stated order and the file that exists speaks.

directory.name: dolphin-emu
directory.citation: [V-script] components/dolphin/component_functions.sh:3 pins $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dolphin-emu/Dolphin.ini and :16-19 the Load trees below $XDG_DATA_HOME/dolphin-emu — one directory name under both bases, which is how Dolphin's own user directory works

GFX.ini.citation: [V-live] the graphics settings sit beside the Dolphin.ini components/dolphin/component_functions.sh:3 pins, in the same emulator-owned config directory

directory.name: primehack
directory.citation: [V-source/V-binary] the build RetroDECK ships (component master-230724.27) is shiiion/dolphin 81bfb96, whose CommonPaths.h:22 sets NORMAL_USER_DIR "primehack"; the shipped components/primehack/bin/primehack carries ".primehack/" as the legacy directory it would migrate from and no ".dolphin-emu/", and components/primehack/component_functions.sh:3 pins $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/primehack to match

io.github.shiiion.primehack.citation: [V-source/V-binary/V-live] the Flathub flatpak EmuDeck installs (emuDeckPrimehack.sh:5-6, version 1.0.9) is built from shiiion/dolphin 53f53e0, whose CommonPaths.h:21 sets NORMAL_USER_DIR "dolphin-emu"; its bin/dolphin-emu carries ".dolphin-emu/" and no ".primehack/", EmuDeck names ~/.var/app/io.github.shiiion.primehack/config/dolphin-emu/Dolphin.ini (:7) and links the save trees below .../data/dolphin-emu (:57-59). directory.name: xemu/xemu
directory.citation: [V-live] xemu keeps its own tree at $XDG_DATA_HOME/xemu/xemu, the doubled segment its own base path — not the config-home spelling components/xemu/component_functions.sh:3 names, which is the file the arrangement writes and not the one xemu reads (#250)

xemu.toml.citation: [V-binary/V-script] the shipped binary takes its base path from SDL_GetPrefPath, which on Linux is $XDG_DATA_HOME/<org>/<app>/; RetroDECK says the same while linking a config-tree directory there — 'linking back to original location where component will look' (components/xemu/component_prepare.sh:16-17)

directory.name: duckstation
directory.citation: [V-source] the DataRoot is the duckstation directory below whichever base the launch picks (qthost.cpp:562-582 at stenzek/duckstation@64655818e); components/duckstation/component_functions.sh:3-12 pin the config-home spelling

settings.ini.citation: [V-source] the DataRoot is $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/duckstation where that variable is set and absolute, else ~/.local/share/duckstation (qthost.cpp:562-582 at stenzek/duckstation@64655818e), and settings.ini lives inside it; no file records which branch a launch took, so both are candidates in that order

melonDS.ini.citation: [V-source] the pre-1.0 file Config::Load falls back to where no TOML exists, read line by line as the built-in migration (LoadLegacyFile, Config.cpp:705-717 at melonDS 1.1) from the same directory as the TOML
